title: Gateway restart
note: 10 kills of the supervised latch serve child 75 s apart: 8 observed recoveries of 2.1-2.5 s (p95 2.5 s) on the final build; 4.0-4.5 s (p95 4.5 s over 10) before the address filter. Every recovery ended on the relay carrier because the restarted helper's LAN listener moves to a new port.
